title: P03 — Build the frame conformance harness
description:
## Dispatch packet P03
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D02,D14 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
toolchain
Primary paths: packages/renderer/src; tests/conformance; package.json. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Implement fixture runner with pinned browser/fonts, seeded order permutations, pixel comparison and artifact report. Add npm run test:conformance and a deterministic DOM fixture before testing real effects.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
deliberately wall-clock-driven fixture fails; pure frame fixture passes sequential/reverse/random/two-partition runs.

## Dependencies
videoml-684f74 (P02)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.
